starter_files.contents:
# Text and Log Analyzer

Analyze text files and produce a useful statistical report.

## Required features

- Line and word counts
- Keyword search
- Frequency statistics
- Output export

## Topics
Strings, runes, maps, buffered I/O, regular expressions, errors, and testing.

## Setup and verification
Install a supported Go release, use a module, run `gofmt -w .`, `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and the relevant security checks. No production credentials are needed for the starter. For database/network stages, use a local or test environment and inject configuration through environment variables.

## Status
Starter scaffold only. Complete every milestone, add tests and document actual commands before treating the project as finished.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Setup commands work in a clean environment.
Tests, configuration requirements, and deployment steps are documented.

review_method: automated checks plus human review; no isolated arbitrary-code runner is assumed
